breaking_news.headline: DOJ charges Google staffer over Polymarket trades netting $1.2 million
breaking_news.summary: It's the second known case of the federal government filing criminal charges against someone who allegedly used insider information to make a large profit on a prediction market site.

breaking_news.headline: Ferrari unveiled its first EV model. The response has been lukewarm
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks to Mack Hogan of Inside EVs about the lukewarm consumer response to Ferrari's first electric vehicle.

breaking_news.headline: These swing voters are adding high gas prices into their political calculations
breaking_news.summary: As part of NPR's Swing Shift project checking in with swing voters, these Americans are split on who is to blame for high gas prices but they all agree it has an impact on their personal finances.

breaking_news.headline: Trump wants a gas tax holiday. There's a much bigger problem looming
breaking_news.summary: Suspending the federal gasoline tax could save drivers up to 18.4 cents per gallon. But it would drain the fund meant to cover roadbuilding and repairs — a fund that's already in trouble.

breaking_news.headline: This is how close American households are to the financial edge
breaking_news.summary: A new report shows that nearly half of U.S. households did not earn enough to cover their necessities in 2024.

breaking_news.headline: FIFA's World Cup ticket sales outraged fans. Now they are under investigation
breaking_news.summary: FIFA has always had a peculiar way to sell tickets to the World Cup. It never faced any major issues — until prices soared for the 2026 tournament.

breaking_news.headline: CBS' Bari Weiss overhauls '60 Minutes,' fires top producer and reporters
breaking_news.summary: The new head of CBS News is flexing her muscles at the network's most storied news program: "60 Minutes." We look at the upheaval.

breaking_news.headline: Here's how we're coping with high gas prices, according to Costco and Walmart
breaking_news.summary: Sky-high gas prices have drivers going out of their way for discounts at the pump. Oil executives warn that even higher prices might be on the horizon.

breaking_news.headline: Spain's Sánchez digs in after eight years as PM as wave of scandals threatens survival
breaking_news.summary: Corruption probes of colleagues and relatives have put Spain's premier into a fight for survival.

breaking_news.headline: Ebola spread in DR Congo 'alarming', charity warns, as WHO chief visits worst-hit area
breaking_news.summary: Médicins Sans Frontières says that never before has an Ebola outbreak recorded so many cases so soon after its declaration.

breaking_news.headline: Four more men freed from flooded Laos cave after 10 days
breaking_news.summary: Two of the seven villagers who entered the narrow tunnels in search for gold on 20 May are still missing.

breaking_news.headline: Oscar-winning Star Wars editor Marcia Lucas dies aged 80
breaking_news.summary: The film editor and ex-wife of director George Lucas was widely recognised as a pivotal creative force behind the original space trilogy.

breaking_news.headline: 'No-one feels safe now': Residents of Romanian city hit by drone share fears
breaking_news.summary: People have just begun returning to check on their homes in the block that was hit early on Friday morning.

breaking_news.headline: Italy bans Kanye West and Travis Scott concerts over security concerns
breaking_news.summary: Local authorities say the cancellation of other West concerts had played a role in the decision.

breaking_news.headline: No deal announced after Trump meeting to make 'final determination' on Iran
breaking_news.summary: The US president met his advisers, after officials confirmed the US and Iran had agreed a framework of a deal.

breaking_news.headline: US, UK and Australia to develop underwater drone technology
breaking_news.summary: The technology, developed under the Aukus military pact, is aimed at protecting undersea cables and boosting naval defence.

breaking_news.headline: When trade soured, this American liquor maker moved to Canada
breaking_news.summary: Sales of the fruity liqueur popular with Canadian students had plummetted north of the border as provinces retaliated against Trump tariffs.

breaking_news.headline: US government prepares to print $250 note featuring Trump's face
breaking_news.summary: Federal law bars printing images of living people on US currency, but Trump allies in Congress are moving to make an exception.

breaking_news.headline: Humanoid robots 'the future' of car making, says BMW
breaking_news.summary: BMW is introducing humanoid robots to a car plant in Europe, building on similar projects in the US.

breaking_news.headline: 'I've applied for more than 400 roles' - how young people are facing the job shortage
breaking_news.summary: The BBC has been hearing from young people who are struggling to find work about how they are tackling the challenge.
